title: Headless UI capture should flush pending PNG readbacks before short-run teardown
body: The existing test_headless_ui_graph offscreen capture queues BeginCaptureRenderTargetToPng asynchronously. With the original RunOptions exitAfterFrames=3, the opt-in ut-text capture passed rendering but exited without a PNG; I had to extend the capture run to 8 frames so PollPendingCaptures retired the readback. Suggested consolidation: make the headless capture helper await or flush its pending readback during teardown, so capture tests do not guess a frame budget.
